parameters.name: DynamicSql
parameters.description: Specifies whether the SQL statement is an aggregation statement.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time.

The value must be UTC time in the format of YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of returned rows of the SQL statement.

parameters.name: SqlId
parameters.description: The ID of the SQL statement.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start time.

The value must be UTC time in the format of YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

parameters.name: TraceId
parameters.description:
The trace ID of the executed query, which is the value of TraceId returned by DescribeSQLSamples.
> Note 
Not all trace IDs of slow SQL statements can be used to query the original text.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro describe-sample-sql-raw-texts --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --tenant-id ob2mr3oae00000 --start-time 2023-04-12T04:38:38Z --end-time 2023-04-12T05:38:38Z --db-name test_db --sql-id 8D6E8400000B8FB1823D199E2CA10000 --trace-id YB420A700EFB-00060D53E42D0C61-0-0 --limit 20 --dynamic-sql true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro DescribeSampleSqlRawTexts --region cn-hangzhou --DynamicSql true --TenantId ob2mr3oae00000 --EndTime '2023-04-12T05:38:38Z' --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --StartTime '2023-04-12T04:38:38Z' --TraceId 'YB420A700EFB-00060D53E42D0C61-0-0' --DbName test_db --Limit 20 --SqlId 8D6E8400000B8FB1823D199E2CA10000
